history.summary: A freehold 592 sqft 1BR at $998k / $1,686 PSF, 620m from Dakota MRT (Circle Line) in D15. Accessible sub-$1M freehold quantum with the top technical score in the batch (736, on frontier), but only 8 URA transactions make the 4.47% rate unreliable and the asking PSF sits ~8% above the $1,564 median.
history.rating_rationale: Top score (736) and frontier status are appealing, but the data is thin: 8 txns is below any reliability bar, and $1,686 PSF is ~8% over the $1,564 median (a premium, not a discount). It's a boutique FH 1BR — niche resale segment, lumpy liquidity. Counterweights: sub-$1M FH quantum and 620m to Dakota (Circle Line) keep it investable, not avoidable.
